verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented Fastmail export feature, and no mention of downloading mail, contacts or calendars as open-format files such as mbox, vCard or iCalendar. JMAP is an open standard API that a developer could use to pull data out, but that is a building block rather than an export capability. The 'Import your mail' docs and community migration stories describe moving data into Fastmail, not leaving it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
